codePath: src/app/api/uploads/[assetId]/file/route.js: metadata/authentication, optional public CDN redirect, otherwise full database byte fetch before constructing response
interpretation: Measure authorized database fallback separately from CDN and client transfer. Missing CDN URLs are not evidence that an asset is eligible for public publication. Additional workers multiply byte-cache memory and database connections; they do not eliminate these downloads.
databaseLimit: Cumulative counters do not establish a current deadlock rate or the cause of an individual request. No production settings were changed.
